intro.h2: We fix what is behind the wall, then make it look new
paragraphs: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC does remodeling in Pasadena, TX, and the work often starts where other jobs stop: behind the drywall. One homeowner's 60-year-old dining room had been damaged by termites. Enrique removed and replaced the damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, then painted the room.

That is the pattern in our reviews. Demolition is in our name because we do the tear-out ourselves, then rebuild, whether that is a damaged wall, a bathroom addition or an open commercial space with new floors. Customers describe the team as professional, conscientious and easy to talk to, and say they would hire us again.

items.name: Damage repair: termites, drywall and studs
items.blurb: When termites or moisture get into a wall, paint alone will not fix it. We open the wall, remove damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, replace them and finish with fresh paint so the room looks like nothing happened.

image.alt: Termite-damaged wood header above a window with the drywall removed

items.name: Demolition and tear-out
items.blurb: Demolition is part of our name and part of almost every job. We strip rooms back to the studs, protect the rest of your home with plastic sheeting and clear the way for the rebuild.

image.alt: Worker clearing a dining room stripped to the studs, with plastic sheeting protecting the next room

items.name: Bathroom additions and home remodeling
items.blurb: A recent customer had Enrique and his team build a bathroom addition and said their skills, professionalism and communication were off the charts. We take on residential remodeling of rooms, closets and bathrooms in and around Pasadena.

image.alt: Small closet with fresh grey paint, new baseboards, a wooden hanging rod and carpet

items.name: Commercial remodeling
items.blurb: We remodel commercial spaces as well as homes, from the floor to the walls and doors. This large open room got new wood-look flooring, freshly painted walls and new doors, so the space was clean, bright and ready to be used again.

image.alt: Large empty commercial room with new wood-look plank flooring, white walls and exposed ducting

items.name: Kitchen remodeling and countertops
items.blurb: Our Facebook page lists kitchen remodeling and countertops among our services. If your kitchen needs new counters or a full remodel, call and tell us about the space, and we will talk through what is involved.

items.title: We fix the cause, not just the surface
items.text: On the termite job we replaced the damaged studs and insulation, not just the drywall. The homeowner called us very professional and conscientious and said he would call again.

items.title: Communication customers notice
items.text: The bathroom addition customer said our skills, professionalism and communication were off the charts, and that he would rehire us.

items.title: Homes and businesses
items.text: Our Facebook page describes us as remodeling in general, residential and commercial, plus demolition. The same crew can work on your house or your business space.

items.title: One crew from tear-out to paint
items.text: Because we handle demolition ourselves, there is no handoff between a demo company and a remodeler. The team that opens the wall is the team that closes it.

about.h2: About Enrique and the M&J team
about.text: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC is a remodeling and demolition company in Pasadena, TX. In our Google reviews customers name Enrique as the person leading the work, along with his team. The jobs they describe are the kind that need both skills: opening up a 60-year-old dining room damaged by termites and rebuilding it, and building a bathroom addition from scratch. Every review on Google is five stars, and customers use words like professional, conscientious and pleasant to work with. We work for homeowners and for businesses.
about.owner_role: Leads the work, named in Google reviews (exact title not published)

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (832) 691-1171 and tell us what is going on: damage you found, a room you want changed, or a space to remodel.

steps.title: Look at the problem
steps.text: We come out, look at the room and, if there is damage, find out how far it goes before we quote the work.

steps.title: Demolition
steps.text: We protect the rest of your home or business, then remove damaged or dated materials down to what is solid.

steps.title: Rebuild and finish
steps.text: New studs, insulation, drywall, flooring or fixtures go in, followed by paint and trim so the room is ready to use.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk the finished space with you and go over what was replaced, so you know exactly what is behind your walls.

service_area.h2: Remodeling in Pasadena, TX and nearby
service_area.text: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC is based in Pasadena, TX. Our Google profile does not list a street address, because we come to you. We take on homes and commercial spaces. If you are in Pasadena or close by and you are not sure we cover your street, call (832) 691-1171 and ask before you book. A few photos of the room help us give you a quick answer.

items.q: Do you repair termite and water damage?
items.a: Yes. In one of our reviewed jobs we restored a 60-year-old dining room damaged by termites: we removed and replaced the damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, then painted. If you have found soft wood, stains or damage behind a wall, call and we will come and look.

items.q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
items.a: Yes. We describe ourselves as remodeling in general, residential and commercial, plus demolition. Our photos include an open commercial room finished with new flooring and paint. Call with the size of the space, what it is used for and what you need done.

items.q: Can you build a bathroom addition?
items.a: Yes. A customer had Enrique and his team build a bathroom addition and reviewed it with five stars, mentioning skills, professionalism and communication. Every addition is different, so we start by looking at your home and talking through the layout you want.

Our Google profile lists us as open 24 hours, seven days a week. The easiest way to reach us is to call (832) 691-1171 or email en071591@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of the room or damage.

We are based in Pasadena, TX and travel to our customers; our Google profile lists no street address to visit. If you are in or near Pasadena, call and tell us your address and the job, and we will let you know if we can take it on.

final_cta.h2: Found damage, or ready to remodel?
final_cta.text: Call M&J and talk to the team that will do the tear-out and the rebuild.
